title: KAITO — The Troupe Leader's Day Off〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others are probably preparing for their final performance right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I've seen them rehearse a number of times already and know the story very well at this point, but I'd really like to witness to their big moment...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still, it'd be irresponsible of me, the troupe leader, to disappear for an entire day.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, there you are...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you know how much time we spent looking for you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Luka? MEIKO?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're seriously asking us that?!
We have to go, now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?! W-Wait!
Where are we going?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Again, seriously?!
We're gonna go catch the final performance of the Little Mermaid☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually got to see it yesterday, but I have to say, it was a wonderful show. Would you like to come see it with us, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd love to, but the plushies are supposed to do their show today...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that!
You've been fired as troupe leader♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Just for today.
Oh, here comes the new troupe leader.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just for today, I, the great Miku, will be the troupe leader!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Three cheers for Miku!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Hooray♪ Long live the new leader♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So for today, you've been deposed as troupe leader, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Now do you get it?
Your schedule's been cleared up, so let's hurry up and go see the show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, all of you... Did you do this for...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
Because you're always there to help us, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why we want to give back and make sure you get to have fun for a change too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now then...
KAITO, shall we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's go☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, you don't need to yank my arm like that...!

rows.Speaker: Plushies & Miku
rows.Line:
Have fun, you guys♪
Enjoy♪
Beach Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<There we go.
Wait... Where are we?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, this looks like Nene's script.
We must be just off stage.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Nonetheless, we should still be able to catch most of their show.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'll need to thank Miku and the others when I get back...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank you, MEIKO, Luka...
Huh? Where'd they go?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <MEIKO? Luka? Where are you?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
<Over here!
Tsukasa's phone was stuck in his bag.>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Same with Emu's.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <That's a shame. Shall we move over to Nene's phone where KAITO is?>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line:
<Sure.
Please make some room for us, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Room for all of us...?
Hold on, is that even possible...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Miku, Rin and Len said that they were all able to fit onto Emu's phone, so I don't see why not♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's them, we're us. Are you sure that we can...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Hi!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ow!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry about that!
We should've warned you that we were coming in hot.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Th-That's okay...
But it is getting a little cramped...>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Hello...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No, wait! Th-There's no more room!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, you're right. Having you sandwiched between us does seem a bit unfair, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, MEIKO, what if I sat on your lap?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<L-Luka, wait!
This isn't like when you use my lap as a pillow. If you try sitting on my lap now...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Eep!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wah!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <MEIKO... KAITO... I'm so sorry...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Ugh... I tried to warn you!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Please, you two... I'm getting crushed...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Phew. This is much better.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, just in time too. I think the show's about to start.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (The story about a somewhat introverted Little Mermaid and her extroverted siblings. No two characters are alike, and they're off to a good start...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Tsukasa and Emu have been captured.
That means the climax is coming up.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. The Little Mermaid tries to save her siblings by drinking the strange potion and transforming into a robot.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hm? But I don't see Robo-Nene standing by...)

N-No, stop!
Don't kick it! This robot's a good guy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<What's going on?
Where's all that commotion coming from...?>

Oh no...!
H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<That voice... Nene?!
Could she be in trouble?!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<She just might be.
Not only that, it's almost Robo-Nene's cue to go out...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <No! As much as I want to help, I can't move from this spot!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Tsukasa and Emu are still on stage too, so that leaves...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's he is! Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it's you three. You came to see our show? You could've told us that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That can wait. We heard Nene's voice coming from the other side of the stage...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We haven't seen Robo-Nene at all either, and she is supposed to go on stage soon.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you for the warning.
I'll see what's going on right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness!
Curtain call! They did it!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They really did.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And despite the trouble they ran into, they managed to turn a bad situation into an incredibly good one.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know, right?! Nene's ad-libbing was amazing! She really pulled through for them there!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, she did. Seeing how much they've all grown makes me so proud.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you both for inviting me here today...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Actually, Miku's the one you should be thanking♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's true. She's the one who initially mentioned anything about wanting you to see their show live.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'll make sure to thank her when I get back.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Good!>
